retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century graphic style featuring loose charcoal-style sketches of a male figure in various poses over a flat ochre background with tight, geometric sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: ochre and black ink portrait illustration
excludeWhen: modern digital vector art is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition consisting of three overlapping charcoal-style sketches of a man in a suit and fedora, rendered in black ink on a solid ochre-brown field, paired with left-aligned, tightly tracked geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping charcoal sketches creating a vertical central axis
High contrast between black ink and flat ochre background
Typography anchored to the upper left quadrant
Varying scales of the same subject to create depth
coreInvariants: Monochromatic black ink for all illustrations
Loose, gestural line work with visible hatching

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three portraits of varying sizes: a large face on the right, a full-body profile in the center, and a smaller bust at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, detailed face on the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down the central figure, and circles back to the large face on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side and around the edges, emphasizing the central cluster.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink for sketches and primary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the main artist name highlight
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-tone background with high-value black and white elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a short, curved leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same geometric family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tight geometric aesthetic and circular forms.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uniform weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid ochre-brown background. Overlay three black charcoal-style sketches of a man in a 1960s suit and fedora: one large face on the right, one full-body profile in the center, and one smaller bust at the bottom, all overlapping slightly.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top-left quadrant. Use white for the top line and black for the subsequent lines. Ensure extremely tight tracking and left alignment.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid ochre color?
Are the sketches rendered in a loose, charcoal-like black ink?
Is the typography tightly tracked and left-aligned?
Does the text use a geometric sans-serif font?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific celebrity likenesses
Do not use existing brand logos
Do not use copyrighted song titles

mustAchieve: Authentic charcoal texture in the lines

postGenerationChecks: Check that the charcoal lines have visible texture and varying thickness.
Ensure the text tracking is tight enough that letters almost touch.
Verify the ochre color is consistent across the entire background.
Confirm the three sketches are distinct in scale and pose.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color background + Overlapping charcoal portraits + Tightly tracked geometric sans-serif typography = Mid-century editorial style.
